Could you review our records in June 2022 and identify which countries have the longest streak of consecutive inserted city dates? Please list the 2-letter length country codes of these countries.

[A]
SQL:
WITH june_data AS (
    SELECT 
        country_code_2,
        CAST(insert_date AS DATE) as insert_date
    FROM cities 
    WHERE insert_date LIKE '2022-06-%'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        country_code_2,
        insert_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY insert_date) as rn,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY insert_date - INTERVAL 1 DAY) as rn_prev
    FROM june_data
),
streaks AS (
    SELECT 
        country_code_2,
        insert_date,
        rn - rn_prev + 1 as streak_group
    FROM ranked
),
streak_lengths AS (
    SELECT 
        country_code_2,
        streak_group,
        COUNT(*) as streak_length
    FROM streaks
    GROUP BY country_code_2, streak_group
),
max_streaks AS (
    SELECT 
        country_code_2,
        MAX(streak_length) as max_consecutive_days
    FROM streak_lengths
    GROUP BY country_code_2
)
SELECT * FROM max_streaks ORDER BY max_consecutive_days DESC, country_code_2

SELECT country_code_2, streak_id::INTEGER as streak_id_int, streak_length
FROM (
    WITH daily_cities AS (
        SELECT 
            country_code_2,
            TRY_CAST(insert_date AS DATE) as insert_date
        FROM cities
        WHERE insert_date >= '2022-06-01' AND insert_date <= '2022-06-30'
    ),
    with_lag AS (
        SELECT 
            country_code_2,
            insert_date,
            LAG(insert_date) OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY insert_date) as prev_date
        FROM daily_cities
    ),
    with_gap AS (
        SELECT 
            country_code_2,
            insert_date,
            prev_date,
            CASE 
                WHEN prev_date IS NULL THEN 1
                ELSE CASE WHEN (insert_date - prev_date) = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
            END as is_new_streak
        FROM with_lag
    ),
    streak_groups AS (
        SELECT 
            country_code_2,
            insert_date,
            SUM(CAST(is_new_streak AS INTEGER)) OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY insert_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) as streak_id
        FROM with_gap
    ),
    streak_lengths AS (
        SELECT 
            country_code_2,
            streak_id,
            COUNT(*) as streak_length
        FROM streak_groups
        GROUP BY country_code_2, streak_id
    )
    SELECT country_code_2, streak_id, streak_length
    FROM streak_lengths
    WHERE streak_length >= 10
)
ORDER BY streak_length DESC, country_code_2 ASC
